reason: An MCP server that provides image understanding, OCR, and image comparison through a configured OpenAI-compatible vision API for text-only agents.

summaries.zh: 通过兼容 OpenAI 的视觉 API 为文本智能体提供图像理解、OCR 和多图比较能力。
summaries.en: An MCP server that gives text-only agents image understanding, OCR, and multi-image comparison through an OpenAI-compatible vision API.

capabilities: Analyzes local images, HTTP(S) images, and data URLs
Sends image content and prompts to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision API
Supports OCR, document, chart, UI, code, spatial, description, and image comparison modes
